This run follows a repair pass that closed 4 defects an independent review found in the first implementation (source_sha 275e906): (1) MCPClient could leak the bearer credential to a cross-origin HTTP redirect target -- fixed with a redirect-refusing opener and empirically reproduced/confirmed fixed against two real loopback servers in evals/hosted/test_mcp_client.py; (2) approved_max_usd was validated but never enforced live -- fixed via a required budget.max_cost_per_call_usd manifest field and a pre-call projected-cost check; (3) call_tool silently auto-initialized a session, undercounting the first budgeted call by one -- fixed by requiring an explicit initialize() the caller can budget for; (4) the positive and empty-case phases shared one credential/account, making cross-account leakage untestable -- fixed by requiring a second, independently validated empty_case_hosted_mcp manifest target. No corpus or acceptance-threshold values were changed to make anything pass.

No live semantic measurement has ever been taken: EMBEDDINGS_API_KEY is not provisioned, T23.42's real provider adapter is not merged, and no hosted test account (or its required second, isolated empty-case account) is seeded. --live is fully implemented and covered by real-wire tests (redirect/isError/allowlist tests against real loopback servers, and budget-exhaustion/max_calls=1/near-token-cap/pre-network-dollar-cap/separate-credential tests against a real local HTTP server) but has never been run against an actual hosted endpoint; every Hit@5 number this task has ever produced is a fixtures-only mechanical rehearsal (hash-bag / fixed-vector / real-lexical-control arms), never a quality PASS -- see embedding-eval.md.

The production lexical fallback (internal/index.LiteralFTSQuery) implicit-ANDs every query term including stopwords, so natural-language questions almost never lexically match a short fact statement regardless of this corpus's designed word-overlap category -- verified directly against the real built serenity binary; see embedding-eval.md 'Known limits'.
Empty-case fixture arm approximates 'forgotten/expired' as 'never authored' since T23.43 does not own the remember/forget/expiry pipeline (T23.42/44/48).
